text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Non-stop, can't stop this love~♪ 'Cause I 
don't want this to end as unrequited 
love~☆

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the singing and choreography are 
flawless! I can't wait to see it on stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Light Hello, an event producer who 
works on numerous lives and projects.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan event organized by her for a retired 
former top idol, where Smart Falcon will 
make a guest appearance.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Asking Falcon-san was definitely the right 
choice. Please deliver those feelings of 
"love" through song on stage as well!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Standing on the same stage as her... 
Even now, it feels like a dream. I'll 
deliver all my feelings with everything 
I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This song is packed full of "love." So 
I've been singing it with all the love 
Falco can possibly muster, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought, I don't feel like I 
can get the message across like this.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's feelings aren't just about 
"liking" them! There are so many more 
feelings I want to convey to that person!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right...! Hey, Hello-san! Would it be okay 
if I wrote the lyrics myself!? I want to 
put my own feelings into this song using 
my own words!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Rearranging the lyrics, you say...? —But 
we have so little time left before the 
performance...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I won't do anything half-hearted! As an 
Umadol, I promise to give you a perfect 
performance!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. I trust you. I'll consult 
with each section as well to make sure we 
make adjustments for the best possible 
performance!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the day of the event. It 
was time for Smart Falcon to take the 
stage—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm Smart Falcon! U-Um! I'm so 
happy to meet you! I've admired you for 
so, so long...!

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. Having such a cute person 
like you as a fan makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So... there's something I want to share! 
...I put all my feelings into a song! 
Please listen!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your unfading smile~♪ Forever and always 
in my heart~♪

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that's my song! ...Huh? But the 
lyrics are different...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(This was the final song of the tour's 
closing show. Back then, even though she 
must have been exhausted, she sang and 
danced with everything she had... I was 
completely captivated by her.)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Even during your retirement live, you 
were smiling. You stayed true to your 
desire to make your fans smile until the 
very end...!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(Always striving to bring joy to your 
fans, no matter what—you're the top idol I 
look up to!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you" is just not enough♪ Because 
you're still my shine...♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Non-stop, I'm gonna surpass you! 'Cause I 
don't want this to end as just admiration♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(I will... become a top Umadol who 
surpasses even you!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(It's not just about making people smile! 
I'll sing, I'll dance, I'll run— and give 
courage to fans all over the world!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon sang her heart out with all 
her feelings poured into it. The former 
top idol clenched her fist tight, watching 
over her with a serious gaze.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! Did my feelings... reach 
you?

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I felt it. It was so passionate, 
it resonated deep in my chest to the point 
of trembling.

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
Can I ask you something? That outfit looks 
a lot like the one I wore for my 
retirement live concert. Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I modeled it after that outfit. I 
want to catch up to the dazzling you on 
stage. Catch up to you... and surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"With that in mind, I added even more 
sparkle. So that one day, this sparkle 
will become my true brilliance—!"

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Don't forget these feelings. I 
feel like you can reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Trainer, Hello-san! I managed 
to convey every last bit of my feelings!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone was so hyped up, weren't 
they? My own heart... was burning with 
passion too.
choice_data_list: That was truly captivating to watch.

I was moved by your burning passion to 
reach the top!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The dancing, the singing... I put 
everything I have right now into that 
performance...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, next time I stand before everyone, 
I'll have to show them an even more 
grown-up Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like she made everyone smile, I want 
to give courage to everyone too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing her determination with the idol 
she looked up to seemed to make Smart 
Falcon's desire to become a top Umadol 
even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm definitely gonna become one! A 
top Umadol♪

text_block_list.name: Former Top Idol
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! Let's sing on stage together! I want 
to sing with you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Yes! Looking forward to working 
with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon singing on stage with the 
idol she admired. It felt like the day she 
herself would shine at the very top wasn't 
too far off.
